purpose: Masala Short (draft): युद्ध से एक दिन पहले माँ ने बताया सच… कर्ण और कुंती 😢 | Mahabharat Emotional Story #shorts

scenes.scene: Medium two-shot at eye level, the camera slightly to one side, so one figure is seen in three-quarter view and the other in near-profile. Setting: the bank of the river Ganga at dawn in ancient India, the rising sun behind the mist. On the LEFT of the frame: Kunti (a 60-year-old Indian woman: graceful oval face with fine wrinkles around the eyes and lips, large sorrowful dark-brown eyes, fair wheatish skin, long silver-grey hair parted in the middle, a slim upright regal build, about 5 feet 4 inches tall; wearing a plain white silk saree with a thin gold border, its end drawn over her head as a veil, no jewellery), body and face turned towards the right of the frame, eyes on Karna the whole time; steps one step down towards him with her hands half raised, pleading, crying. On the RIGHT of the frame: Karna (a 38-year-old Indian man: strong noble oval face with a straight nose and a firm square jaw, calm deep-set dark-brown eyes, warm golden-brown skin, a short neat black beard, long wavy black hair tied in a loose knot at the back of his head, a tall broad-shouldered muscular warrior's build, about 6 feet 1 inch tall; wearing a saffron silk dhoti, a white cotton cloth draped over one shoulder, a sacred thread across his bare chest, plain gold armbands, no armour and no earrings), body and face turned towards the left of the frame, eyes on Kunti the whole time; stands still, listening, shocked, eyes wet. What happens: Kunti steps closer and tells him who his father is. Only Kunti speaks, in Hindi, clearly, looking at Karna while speaking, with natural, well-synchronised lip movements; Kunti finishes speaking a moment before the shot ends. Karna stays silent, lips closed, only reacting. Exactly 2 figures fully in the frame (Kunti, Karna); each appears only once; nobody else. Nobody looks into the camera lens: the camera is an invisible observer that nobody notices. Everyone is clearly Indian, with brown skin and Indian features, like real actors in an Indian TV serial; never cartoon, anime or plastic-looking. Film look: Photorealistic live-action epic Indian historical drama set in ancient India, shot on a cinema camera, golden dawn light, soft mist over the river, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. Upright, normal orientation (never rotated or upside down). Vertical 9:16 frame for a phone screen, faces in the upper-middle of the picture. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no signboards, no shop signs, no posters, no name plates, no vehicle number plates, no readable letters anywhere.
scenes.dialogue: तुम मेरे पहले पुत्र हो… सूर्यदेव के पुत्र।
scenes.sound: Gentle river water, no other voices, and Kunti's voice: a soft, trembling, regal older woman's voice, speaking Hindi.

checks.line: तुम मेरे पहले पुत्र हो… सूर्यदेव के पुत्र।
